# Model, prompt and approved-knowledge manifest

Status: Pending. Owner Mathew; independent reviewer Devadathan; medical source/translation approval by actual named physician. Bind candidate/time/environment/provider modes without secrets or raw private prompts.

Record actual provider/model identifiers and pinned configuration, embedding dimensionality/index compatibility, transcription/media bounds, prompt/tool schema/confirmation/safety/intake versions, approved source/publication/translation hashes and mandatory-block versions. Do not infer current entitlement/model availability/pricing from an old proposal.

Map all published required products and approved public physician/profile/FAQ/policy/treatment/reference entries to current physician-approved medical/safety content; list no-hit/missing-translation/withdrawn/private exclusions explicitly. Keep patient notes/conversations outside public vectors. Record update/withdrawal freshness deadline and measured propagation, index-to-primary recheck, privacy-minimized entry/version usage metric and replay deduplication.

Bind the 120 EN/ML/TA +40 additional/Romanized evaluation oracle, required channel/actor/source/expected/forbidden outcomes, critical flags, scorer/physician approval and final repetitions. All critical outcomes and medical attribution pass; supported noncritical completion >=95% with defined denominator; blocked tests are not silently removed. Record raw outputs only in restricted permitted evidence and redacted stable references in Git.

Any model/prompt/KB/translation/tool/confirmation/config change identifies invalidated evidence and required targeted/cumulative/critical retest; no blind transfer of prior Pass. Confirm model outage/timeouts/ten active generations plus overload safe fallback and core independence.
